name: tab_hole_margin
expr: hole_grid / 2 - sqrt(max(0 mm * 1 mm, (bore / 2 + plate / 2) * (bore / 2 + plate / 2) - (hole_grid / 2 - plate - tab_clearance) * (hole_grid / 2 - plate - tab_clearance)))

name: tab_length_max
expr: floor(min(4 * plate, 2 * (tab_hole_margin - tab_clearance - relief)) / (1 mm)) * 1 mm

name: corner_width
expr: if(side_rows >= 2, tab_length, min(tab_length, floor((side_depth - (hole_grid / 2 + bore / 2 + plate / 2) - 10 mm) / (1 mm)) * 1 mm))

name: rib_keepout
expr: plate + max(if(legs_on, leg_width + torch_gap, 0 mm) + plate / 2, rib_depth + torch_nozzle_allowance + plate / 2, hole_grid, rib_tab_offset + tab_length / 2 + plate)

name: rib_step_min
expr: ceil(max(rib_depth + torch_nozzle_allowance + plate, 2 * rib_tab_offset + tab_length + plate) / hole_grid) * hole_grid

name: skirt_hole_depth2_sum
expr: side_rows * hole_grid * hole_grid / 4 + hole_grid * hole_grid * side_rows * (side_rows - 1) / 2 + hole_grid * hole_grid * (side_rows - 1) * side_rows * (2 * side_rows - 1) / 6

name: area_x
expr: (table_width - hole_rows * bore) * plate + web_count_x * plate * rib_depth - 2 * side_rows * bore * plate

name: first_moment_x
expr: (table_width - hole_rows * bore) * plate * plate / 2 + web_count_x * plate * rib_depth * (plate + rib_depth / 2) - 2 * bore * plate * skirt_hole_depth_sum

name: second_moment_x
expr: (table_width - hole_rows * bore) * plate^3 / 3 + web_count_x * plate * ((plate + rib_depth)^3 - plate^3) / 3 - 2 * bore * plate * skirt_hole_depth2_sum - 2 * side_rows * plate * bore^3 / 12

name: area_y
expr: (table_length - hole_columns * bore) * plate + web_count_y * plate * rib_depth - 2 * side_rows * bore * plate

name: first_moment_y
expr: (table_length - hole_columns * bore) * plate * plate / 2 + web_count_y * plate * rib_depth * (plate + rib_depth / 2) - 2 * bore * plate * skirt_hole_depth_sum

name: second_moment_y
expr: (table_length - hole_columns * bore) * plate^3 / 3 + web_count_y * plate * ((plate + rib_depth)^3 - plate^3) / 3 - 2 * bore * plate * skirt_hole_depth2_sum - 2 * side_rows * plate * bore^3 / 12

name: sag_formula_max_load
expr: sag_limit * 48 * steel_modulus * min(section_i_x / support_span^3, section_i_y / support_span_y^3) / gravity

name: box_mass_estimate
expr: 7850 kg / (1 m * 1 m * 1 m) * (table_length * table_width * plate + 2 * (table_length + table_width) * rib_depth * plate + ribs_along * table_length * rib_depth * plate + ribs_across * table_width * rib_depth * plate)

name: self_mass_estimate
expr: box_mass_estimate + 7850 kg / (1 m * 1 m * 1 m) * (if(legs_on, 4 * leg_length * leg_area, 0 mm^3) + if(frame_on, 2 * (rail_length_x + rail_length_y) * leg_area, 0 mm^3))

name: design_load_max
expr: floor(min(0.97 * sag_formula_max_load - 0.625 * box_mass_estimate, load_max_by_legs) / (10 kg)) * 10 kg

name: box_mass
label: Mass of the top and its box

name: sag_long
label: Sag at the centre, load and own weight, along the length (estimate)

name: sag_short
label: Sag at the centre, load and own weight, across the width (estimate)

name: own_weight_sag
label: Sag from the table's own weight alone, along the length (estimate)

name: panel_sag
label: Local plate sag under 100 kg between ribs (estimate)

name: leg_capacity_each
label: Leg capacity (least of the rating and of buckling, yield, seams and stud, each divided by 3; estimate)

name: sway_under_push
expr: if(legs_on, push_force * (if(frame_on, (upper_leg^3 + rail_rise^3) / (12 * steel_modulus * leg_i), leg_length^3 / (12 * steel_modulus * leg_i))), 0 mm)
label: Sideways sway under a 1 kN push (estimate)

name: tipping_push
expr: table_mass * gravity * (table_width / 2 - if(legs_on, plate + leg_width / 2 - foot_pad_radius, 0 mm)) / working_height
label: Sideways push at the working height that tips the empty table over its feet

name: edge_tab_length
label: Tabs along the four plate edges (weld length there, measured)

name: weld_share
label: Weld share of the plate edges (%)

name: total_weld_length
expr: edge_tab_length + 4 * corner_width + 4 * ribs_across * ribs_along * tab_length + 2 * (ribs_across + ribs_along) * rib_end_tab
label: Total weld length at the tabs

end_cell_needed
expr: plate + max(if(legs_on, leg_width + torch_gap, 0 mm), rib_depth + torch_nozzle_allowance)

End cell at x = length is wide enough for the torch
End cell at y = 0 is wide enough for the torch
End cell at y = width is wide enough for the torch

top_volume_formula
expr: plate * (table_length * table_width - hole_columns * hole_rows * pi * (bore / 2)^2 - 2 * (tabs_x + tabs_y) * top_notch_area_each - top_slots * slot_area_each) - top_chamfer * top_chamfer / 2 * (2 * table_length + 2 * table_width - 2 * (tabs_x + tabs_y) * (tab_length + 2 * tab_clearance)) + 4 * top_chamfer^3 / 3

name: Volume of the top plate matches its closed form
front_volume_formula
expr: plate * (table_length * (side_depth - tab_recess) - hole_columns * side_rows * pi * (bore / 2)^2 - (tabs_x - 1) * ((tab_step_x - tab_length) * (plate - tab_recess) + pi * relief * relief) - (first_tab_x - tab_length / 2) * (plate - tab_recess) - pi * relief * relief / 2 - (table_length - last_tab_x - tab_length / 2) * (plate - tab_recess) - pi * relief * relief / 2 - 2 * ((corner_width + 2 * tab_clearance) * (plate + tab_clearance) + pi * relief * relief) - ribs_across * ((rib_end_tab + 2 * tab_clearance) * (plate + 2 * tab_clearance) + 2 * pi * relief * relief))

name: Volume of the front skirt matches its closed form
block_system
label: Block system
description: The bore and hole grid your blocks and clamps fit: 16 mm on 50 mm or 100 mm, or 28 mm on 100 mm

name: table_length
label: Table length
min: max(800 mm, (2 + 2 * max(0, ceil((rib_keepout - hole_grid / 2) / hole_grid - 0.5))) * hole_grid)
description: Length of the top. Holes are centred; the top stays within a 3000 by 1500 mm sheet

name: table_width
label: Table width
min: max(400 mm, working_height / 2, if(hole_grid < 100 mm && table_length > 1700 mm, 800 mm, 0 mm), (2 + 2 * max(0, ceil((rib_keepout - hole_grid / 2) / hole_grid - 0.5))) * hole_grid)
description: Width of the top; narrow tables are limited by the legs and ribs

name: working_height
label: Working height
description: Height of the working surface above the floor, with the levelling feet

name: base_style
label: Base
description: Only the box, four legs on levelling feet, or legs joined by rails near the floor

name: leg_section
label: Leg section
description: Square hollow section of the legs and rails, EN 10219

name: design_load
label: Design load
description: Largest load you will put on the table as one lump at its centre. The form limits it to what keeps the sag, with its own weight, within the flatness limit and each leg, foot and weld within its rating

name: tab_length
label: Tab length
description: Length of each weld tab along the edge. Between the tabs the plates meet in plain contact

name: tab_pitch
label: Tab pitch
description: One tab every so far along the edge, rounded to the hole grid because tabs sit between the holes. The share of the edge that is weld is shown below

name: tab_clearance
label: Tab clearance
description: Gap per side between a tab and its slot. 0 is size on size: the tabs are knocked in

name: tab_recess
label: Tab recess
description: How far the end of a tab stops below the outer face of the plate it enters, so nothing stands proud even on plate 3 % under nominal. The weld fills it

name: beam_kerf
label: Beam kerf
description: Width of cut your laser leaves: the round reliefs in the corners of notches and slots are at least this radius. Export true size and let the cutter compensate

title: Welding table
description: A fixture welding table you laser cut and MIG weld yourself. Choose the block system (16 mm or 28 mm holes on a 50 or 100 mm grid), the size and the base. The plates meet in plain contact, with one short recessed tab per pitch, so a weld lies below the datum faces and nothing stands proud; ribs are half-lapped and tab-and-slot located. The form limits the load to what keeps the sag within the flatness limit and the legs within their rating, and gives the mass measured on the model. Export: File > Export..., DXF or SVG, Sheet of set: Plates to cut; STEP for the whole table.
